💬 Iran FM praises exporters’ role, vows full support and cooperation

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s foreign minister praised exporters as front-line soldiers in the country's economic war, pledging full support and cooperation from the ministry.

Abbas Araghchi made the remarks on Wednesday, October 21, at the National Export Day conference.
​
He said the country is currently facing both military threats and extensive economic sanctions. “The reality is that the country is in a state of war, and therefore all decisions must be made within the framework of wartime conditions,” he stated.
​
Araghchi stressed that exports drive production and boost employment, noting that the ministry of foreign affairs has a responsibly to support those active in the export and economic sectors.
​
Emphasizing the crucial role of border crossings in boosting export growth, the foreign minister said that the ministry is working to remove border obstacles and problems to further facilitate exports.
​
Different provinces across the country possess vast capacities that can be utilized to develop economic relations with neighboring countries and beyond, Araghchi said.
